Baldwin Health

Acute Care Hospitals
FOLEY, AL
Independent
Current EHR: Harris MEDHOST Enterprise Clinicals
Version: Harris MEDHOST Enterprise Clinicals
Baldwin Health in Foley, AL, is listed as using MEDHOST EHR, which was acquired by Harris Healthcare in January 2024, suggesting they may now be using Harris MEDHOST Enterprise Clinicals.

Based on my search, here’s what I found regarding Baldwin Health in Foley, AL, and their EMR system:

  • MEDHOST EHR: Several sources indicate that Baldwin Health (South Baldwin Regional Medical Center, before rebranding) uses MEDHOST EHR.
    • Ivy Clinicians (2025) lists MEDHOST as their EHR.
    • PracticeMatch.com mentions “EMR: MedHost” for both Baldwin Health ED in Foley and Baldwin Health FED in Gulf Shores.
    • IES Healthcare also indicates “EMR: Medhost” for their Emergency Medicine APP.

It’s important to note that Harris Healthcare acquired MEDHOST in January 2024. While the hospital might still be using the MEDHOST system, it’s now under the Harris Healthcare umbrella. Therefore, it’s possible they are using Harris MEDHOST Enterprise Clinicals.

Russellville Hospital

100 Beds
Acute Care Hospitals
RUSSELLVILLE, AL
Independent
Current EHR: Harris MEDHOST Enterprise Clinicals
Version: Harris MEDHOST Enterprise Clinicals
The evidence suggests that Russellville Hospital is using MEDHOST, but there is no explicit confirmation that they have adopted Harris MEDHOST Enterprise Clinicals.

Based on the search results, here’s what I found regarding Russellville Hospital and its EMR system:

  • MEDHOST Documentation: A job posting for Russellville Hospital mentions “MedHost Documentation” and notes that it is a 100-bed acute care facility.
  • MedConnect Health Partnership: Russellville Hospital is listed as a “Hospital Partner” with MedConnect Health, which offers physicians interoperability through their EHR interfaces.
  • Harris Acquisition of MEDHOST: Harris Computer Corporation acquired MEDHOST in January 2024. MEDHOST provides clinical and financial solutions, including an integrated EHR, to enhance patient care and financial success.
  • MEDHOST Cloud Services: Russellville Hospital’s diagnostic imaging services page is linked to MEDHOST Cloud Services.
  • MEDHOST Community Login: A MEDHOST Community login portal exists for access to documentation, support, and education material for MEDHOST customers.

Summary of Evidence:

The evidence suggests that Russellville Hospital (in Russellville, AL) has used MEDHOST for its EMR, and continues to use it after the Harris acquisition. Specifically, there is a reference to “MedHost Documentation,” its partnership with MedConnect and its EHR interfaces, and its connection to MEDHOST Cloud Services.

Please Note:

While the search results indicate that Russellville Hospital uses MEDHOST, it does not explicitly confirm whether they are using the “Harris MEDHOST Enterprise Clinicals” version. Since Harris acquired MEDHOST, it is highly likely that Russellville Hospital uses MEDHOST products.

There are no news articles confirming that Jack Hughston Memorial Hospital has adopted Harris MEDHOST Enterprise Clinicals; they have been using MEDHOST prior to its acquisition by Harris in 2024.

Based on the search results, here’s what I found regarding Jack Hughston Memorial Hospital’s EMR system:

  • MEDHOST and Jack Hughston Memorial Hospital:
    • A 2018 court case document mentions that Jack Hughston Memorial Hospital uses MEDHOST and that MEDHOST performs adjustments to the software product purchased by the hospital.
    • A 2019 press release from MEDHOST congratulated Jack Hughston Memorial Hospital for receiving a 5-star quality rating from CMS, with a quote from the CEO, Mark Baker, remarking that the rating is indicative of their commitment to high quality patient care.
  • Harris Healthcare Acquisition of MEDHOST:
    • In January 2024, Harris Computer Corporation acquired MEDHOST.

It appears Jack Hughston Memorial Hospital in Phenix City, AL, used MEDHOST as their EHR system. Harris acquired MEDHOST in 2024, so it is possible they are still using the MEDHOST system now owned by Harris, or that they have transitioned to a different EMR product.

Current EHR: Harris MEDHOST Enterprise Clinicals

A job posting at The Sanctuary at The Woodlands indicates a preference for "Medhost Experience," suggesting they may be using or have used MEDHOST products, but it does not definitively confirm the use of Harris MEDHOST Enterprise Clinicals specifically.

Based on the search results, here’s what I found regarding The Sanctuary at The Woodlands in Cullman, AL, and their potential use of Harris MEDHOST Enterprise Clinicals:

  • MEDHOST Acquisition by Harris: In January 2024, N. Harris Computer Corporation acquired MEDHOST, a provider of EHR and healthcare IT solutions. Harris will continue to operate MEDHOST as a stand-alone business.
  • MEDHOST Products: MEDHOST offers clinical and financial solutions, including an integrated EHR called MEDHOST Enterprise Electronic Health Records (EHR). Their clinical solutions are designed to integrate with this EHR.
  • The Sanctuary at The Woodlands: The Sanctuary at The Woodlands is a psychiatric hospital in Cullman, AL. It is a member of the Alabama Hospital Association.
  • Job Posting: A ZipRecruiter job posting mentions “Medhost Experience Preferred” for an RN position at The Sanctuary at The Woodlands, Cullman, AL.
  • American Hospital Directory: The American Hospital Directory confirms The Sanctuary at the Woodlands is located at 1910 Cherokee Avenue Cullman, AL 35055.

Evidence Summary:

The job posting mentioning “Medhost Experience Preferred” is the strongest indication that The Sanctuary at The Woodlands uses or has used MEDHOST. Since Harris acquired MEDHOST in January 2024, it’s possible they are using Harris MEDHOST Enterprise Clinicals.

Disclaimer:

While the evidence suggests the use of MEDHOST, it doesn’t definitively confirm they are using the “Harris MEDHOST Enterprise Clinicals” specifically. It’s possible they are using a previous version of MEDHOST or a different MEDHOST product. Further investigation would be needed for a conclusive determination.
